race.comment: TSARINE (6) has struck a purple patch of form with back to back wins at Mornington, with the stable flying of late. Some sting out of the track won't hurt and she rates highly on those recent efforts. Draws the carpark here but with even luck she can win again. LATHLAIN (5) has been kept fresh since a good win fresh here. Don't mind that recipe and she is now 3/3 here which is worth noting. Looks a targeted assault and she can repeat the dose. BAJARIA (14) is coming off a dominant win at Kilmore in easier company but has to be respected off the strength of that win. LEGACY BAY (9) resumes. She has the ability if she can turn up at her best.
